title: A report check refuses an Input Needed item whose page item is closed
why: Owner 11:44 CST Nov 8, via the coordinator: the coordinator listed items 214, 381, 383 and 222 to the owner as open, and all four were closed. Its report did not read the page item status first. Harm: the owner is asked again for what he already answered. Fix: the report guard reads each cited page item's status and refuses an Input Needed line that cites a closed item.
